Binary Search Tree
BST Supports dynamic-set operations: SEARCH , MINIMUM ,
MAXIMUM, PREDECESSOR, SUCCESSOR, INSERT, and DELETE.
Useful for dictionaries.
* O(log n) worst-case time for complete BST,
* O(n) worst-case time if the tree is a chain of n nodes.
* Expected height of a randomly built BST is O(log n), special BSTs
maintain O(log n) height.

2-3 Trees
1. Every internal node has either 2 or 3 children.
2. All root-to-leaf paths have same length.
3. The elements of the dynamic set are stored only at leaves.
¢ The keys at leaves are sorted left-to-right in ascending order.
4. Aninternal node stores 3 directives
* min,, minz, min3 — smallest keys in left, mid and right
subtrees, resp.
* mingz and right subtree may not exist.
(It is possible to use only min, and mins).
